about: Lakeshore is a town in Essex County, stretching along Lake St. Clair east of Windsor rather than forming a single urban core. Belle River is the main lakeside centre; Comber, Woodslee, Stoney Point, and Emeryville sit among farms, greenhouses, and shoreline subdivisions. The town was amalgamated from several former municipalities. About 40,000 people live in Lakeshore.
seoSummary: Essex County town on Lake St. Clair east of Windsor, anchored by Belle River and farm hamlets.
